novelty_claim: Uses Wasserstein distance from optimal transport theory to detect regime changes via distribution shifts.
what_is_novel: First use of Wasserstein distance for direct trading signals
Regime detection via distribution shift (not volatility or correlation)
Stability requirement before entry to filter false signals
Immediate exit on regime change detection

novelty_assessment.key_innovation: Wasserstein distance for regime detection - proper metric on distributions

discovery_source: LLM discovered, implemented, and optimized - Sharpe improved from 0.25 to 1.62
